newCase.title: New case
newCase.subtitle: An Elastic or Wazuh case in the Incident Case Input v1.0 format. The backend checks every rule before it accepts it.
newCase.placeholder: Paste the case here or drop a .json file
newCase.empty: Paste or upload a case first.
newCase.syntax: This is not valid JSON. Check line {{line}}, column {{column}}.

contract.title: What the backend checks
contract.alerts: Between {{min}} and {{max}} alerts per case, each from {{sources}}. Unknown fields inside raw_alert are kept as they are.

accepted.title: Case accepted
accepted.body: Case {{id}} is stored and ready to investigate.

invalid.body: Nothing was stored. Fix these and submit again.
invalid.stale: You changed the case after this check. Submit again to recheck it.

duplicate.title: This case was already submitted
duplicate.body: Its case_id has been accepted before. Give it a new case_id to submit it again.

offline.title: Can't reach the backend
offline.body: Check that the backend is running on port 8000, then try again.

failed.title: The backend answered {{status}}
failed.noDetail: It sent no details. The backend terminal log should say more.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong reading the answer
unexpected.body: The browser could not read what came back: {{message}}

entry.title: Who is investigating?
entry.body: Your name goes on every review you record. This Alpha has no passwords yet, so the name stays in this browser only.
entry.help: Use the name your team knows you by.

missing.title: No case with this ID
missing.body: The backend has no case stored under this application ID. It may be a typo, or the backend database was reset.

notRun.title: Not investigated yet
notRun.body: The case is stored. Run the agent to get its report.

run.title: Investigating the case
run.body: The agent correlates the alerts, maps ATT&CK techniques, builds the timeline and checks the attached IoCs. The demo case takes a few seconds. Larger cases can take a few minutes.

failed.timeout: The investigation ran out of time

pageTimeout.title: No answer after {{limit}}
pageTimeout.body: The backend never answered. It may have stopped, or the agent may still finish. Reload this page in a few minutes to check for the report.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong reading the answer

failed.kept: Your case is still stored, so you can run it again without submitting it twice.

hypotheses.none: The agent formed no hypothesis for this case.

evidence.differs: The case holds this value. The report cites {{value}}
evidence.notFound: Not found in the submitted case
evidence.caseFailed: Couldn't load the submitted case, so the fields can't be checked.
evidence.alertsIntro: Every alert as it was submitted, with the fields the report read from it.
evidence.noFields: The report reads no fields from this alert.

actions.approval: Needs an analyst's approval before anyone acts on it.

mitre.intro: Techniques carry a status, not a confidence. A candidate matches the alert pattern and still needs an analyst to confirm it.
mitre.none: The agent mapped no ATT&CK techniques for this case.

review.title: Analyst review
review.intro: Validate, correct or reject each finding and say why. The agent proposes, you decide.
review.oneReview: Each finding decision is stored separately for this investigation.
review.problems_one: {{count}} thing is missing before the review can be saved.
review.problems_other: {{count}} things are missing before the review can be saved.
review.decisionMissing: Pick a decision for this finding.
review.findingNoteHint: Why you decided this. For a correction, write what the right conclusion is.
review.outcomeSuggested: Suggested from your decisions: {{status}}. You can pick another one.
review.outcomeWaiting: Decide every finding to get a suggestion.
review.outcomeNoFindings: The agent reached no findings to decide, so pick the outcome for the whole report.
review.generalNoteHint: Anything about the report as a whole.
review.kept: Your decisions and notes are still here. Try again when the backend answers.

conflict.title: This investigation can no longer take a review
conflict.restarted: The backend restarted after this investigation ran, so the paused run that waits for a review is gone.
conflict.reviewed: This run already has a review, maybe saved from another tab.
conflict.other: The backend refused the review for this run.
conflict.kept: Your decisions and notes are saved in this browser. Investigate again and they come back filled in, ready to send.

stale.title: There is a newer investigation of this case
stale.body: Someone ran the agent again after this report loaded, so this review would land on a run with other findings. Nothing was saved.
stale.kept: Your decisions and notes are saved in this browser and come back for every finding the new run shares.

iocs.none: The case brings no IoC enrichment.

timeline.intro: Times in UTC. Order shows when alerts happened, not that one caused the next.
timeline.none: No dated events outside the unrelated alerts.
timeline.noiseIntro: From alerts the correlation found unrelated to the rest of the case. Kept here, not discarded.
timeline.noNoise: Every alert relates to the rest of the case.
timeline.undatedIntro: These can't be placed in the order, so they are kept apart.
timeline.noUndated: Every event has a usable time.

correlationPanel.title: How the alerts relate
correlationPanel.intro: Alerts are related when they share entities within {{seconds}} seconds. Related is not proof of an attack.
correlationPanel.noGroups: No alerts were related to each other.

assets.observedIntro: Hosts that appear in the alerts, with what was seen on each.
assets.unknowns: What the scope still doesn't know
